query.name: raw_drg_ids
query.command: oql "SELECT eval((SELECT toString(s) AS v FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS o FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS outbounds(r) FROM OBJECTS (d.parsedDecisionRequirements) r) o) s WHERE s.@objectAddress = d.parsedDecisionRequirements.getField(\"decisionRequirementsId\").getValue().getObjectAddress()))[0].v AS drgId FROM io.camunda.zeebe.engine.state.deployment.DeployedDrg d"
